name: Shiori
message: "I know of one more payphone, but this should be the only one you can reach within five minutes from the parking lot."

name: Shiori
message: "We should be able to call Mary-san from here."

name: Shiori
message: "It'd be nice if we could play with her, but she might also attack us."

name: Shiori
message: "And if that happens, I won't know what to do. You might end up getting killed before we can do anything."

name: Shiori
message: "So if you ask me, I'd rather you didn't do it..."

name: Shiori
message: "What do you think? Do you want to call Mary-san?"

name: Shiori
message: "So, what now? Do you want to call Mary-san?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, it's too dangerous. I'm curious too, but there's no point if you wind up dead."

name: Shiori
message: "Well then, shall we head somewhere else?"

name: Shiori
message: "If things get dangerous... I'll handle it somehow."

name: Shiori
message: "I have no idea how I'm going to do it, but I'll figure something out!"

name: Shiori
message: "I've got your back. Now, let's try calling Mary-san."

name: Shiori
message: "Alright, that completes the ritual to summon Mary-san."

name: Shiori
message: "All that's left is to wait for Mary-san to call—"

name: Mary-san
message: "Hello. It's Mary-san. I'll be there right away."

name: Shiori
message: "Next... was your smartphone, right? Let's wait for her to call again."

name: Shiori
message: "Did you just... provoke her? Why...? Are you stressed or something?"

name: Shiori
message: "Was that really okay? Maybe she won't show up because we didn't say the magic words. That or... she's furious, and is already standing behind us..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... it rang back... I guess that still counted."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll answer. If she's angry, I might be able to redirect her hostility onto me..."

name: Mary-san
message: "Hello, this is Mary-san. I'll be right there."

name: Shiori
message: "...If I wasn't imagining it, she sounded pretty ticked."

name: Shiori
message: "She's going to call your smartphone next, right? I'll wait outside."

name: Shiori
message: "An aberration just called us... It rang like it was the most natural thing in the world..."

name: Shiori
message: "I wonder if it's like this everywhere. Or... is it just this city that's strange?"

name: Shiori
message: "There are so many ghosts here... and so many urban legends, too."

name: Shiori
message: "When I was alive, I only enjoyed them as fiction. But now I've become one of those fictional beings myself..."

name: Shiori
message: "It's kind of strange and unsettling at the same time."

name: Shiori
message: "I... just talked about how I was when I was alive, didn't I? It's always like this. My memories come back at the most unexpected moments—"

name: Shiori
message: "What do you want to do? Should I answer for you? I'll be fine even if she attacks."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, you're answering it? Okay, I've got your back."

name: Mary-san
message: "I was... going to use these scissors... to... stab... uh..."

name: Mary-san
message: "Uh, um, ah... your buddy called me, so..."

name: Shiori
message: "You attack people just because they call you?"

name: Mary-san
message: "Huh? Um... that's... how it works, so..."

name: Mary-san
message: "I-I mean, didn't your buddy say... 'come at me'?"

name: Shiori
message: "I might have... gotten a little too angry."

name: Shiori
message: "When I saw Mary-san trying to stab you, I kind of just snapped..."

name: Shiori
message: "Before I knew it, I was swinging an axe at her."

name: Shiori
message: "That was... a first for me. I'm honestly scared of how quickly I turned to violence."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh well. You're safe, and we've verified that Mary-san is real."

name: Shiori
message: "I think I get it now. How to deal with urban legends—with apparitions."

name: Shiori
message: "In the end... it's all about power. Power solves everything."

name: Shiori
message: "Whether it's an aberration or a haunting, power talks."

name: Shiori
message:
"Remember, if anything dangerous comes up:
 C H I K A R A   I S   P O W E R!"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You followed the steps and summoned Mary-san... all the way to her signature line, 'I'm right behind you.'"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Right after that, Mary-san tries to bring her scissors down, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "You kind of broke character just now... but I'll take that as a compliment."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'm impressed by your strength, but what's interesting here is Mary-san's behavior."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "She held a conversation, and when you threatened her with an axe, she agreed to negotiate. In other words, an intelligent aberration..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "And... she really has weakened. In recent years, she hasn't been a symbol of fear so much as a beloved character..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You have my thanks. My knowledge of urban legends has deepened yet again."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I hope you'll look into the ghost marriage as well. I won't force you, of course."

name: Shiori
message: "Sure, we'll check it out if we have the time."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You've grown into full-fledged urban legend hunters."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'll pick out a new urban legend for next time. Give me a little while."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Stay safe, and remember: Gaze into the abyss, and the abyss gazes back at you."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. Hm? Ah, yes, okay. See you again."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I'm sorry. I was just lost in thought for a moment."

name: Shiori
message: "Kashima Reiko-san was shocked, and even I was surprised at myself... That wasn't like me."

name: Shiori
message: "Or maybe, that was how I really..."

name: Shiori
message: "Now's not the time to dwell on that. Shall we go?"
